nodes.description: bytes32 public constant role identifier used by the only(MANAGER_ROLE) modifier to gate privileged functions.
bytes32 public constant keccak256("MintableERC20") token type identifier.
bytes32 constant keccak256("Transfer(address,address,uint256)") used to validate the exit log topic0.
bool storage flag in Initializable guarding the initializer modifier against repeated initialization.
Empty public constructor of MintableERC20Predicate.
External initializer that sets the contract id and grants DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE and MANAGER_ROLE to _owner.
External only(MANAGER_ROLE) deposit entrypoint; decodes amount and performs safeTransferFrom into the predicate.
Public only(MANAGER_ROLE) withdrawal entrypoint; parses RLP log, validates topics, optionally mints, then safeTransfer to withdrawer.
Caller address flowing through _msgSender() into the hasRole permission checks of the only modifier.
IERC20(rootToken).safeTransferFrom external low-level call transferring tokens from depositor (reentrancy surface).
IMintableERC20(rootToken).mint external call minting the balance shortfall during exit (reentrancy surface).
IERC20(rootToken).safeTransfer external low-level call sending amount to withdrawer (reentrancy surface).
Arithmetic subtraction amount - tokenBalance performed when the predicate balance is insufficient; mints the shortfall.
Owner address parameter of initialize receiving the admin and manager roles.
Address parameter of lockTokens whose tokens are pulled into the predicate.
Address parameter of lockTokens receiving tokens on the child chain; only emitted in the event.
ERC20 token address parameter of lockTokens targeted by safeTransferFrom.
ABI-encoded calldata bytes parameter of lockTokens decoded into the amount.
ERC20 token address parameter of exitTokens that is minted from and transferred.
RLP-encoded burn log bytes parameter of exitTokens parsed for withdrawer and amount.
Local uint256 amount decoded from depositData in lockTokens.
Local uint256 amount read from the RLP log to be transferred to the withdrawer.
Local uint256 balance of the predicate for rootToken, compared against amount.
Local address extracted from topic1 of the exit log, the recipient of the transfer.
Local IMintableERC20 instance cast from exitTokens rootToken used for balanceOf and mint.

edges.reason: msg.sender is checked against MANAGER_ROLE before lockTokens executes, restricting who may trigger the token pull.
msg.sender must hold MANAGER_ROLE for exitTokens; a weak or misconfigured role check controls the withdrawal path.
initialize grants privileges based on the supplied _owner rather than on the caller, leaving the initializer unprotected against front-running.
_owner parameter determines which account receives DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE and MANAGER_ROLE during initialization.
depositData is abi.decode'd into the local amount used by the deposit logic.
rootToken parameter controls the external contract invoked by safeTransferFrom.
depositor is the from-address of the safeTransferFrom call.
Decoded amount is passed as the transfer value to safeTransferFrom.
lockTokens unconditionally executes an external token call, making it a reentrancy entry that mutates no state first.
rootToken is cast into the local IMintableERC20 token instance.
tokenBalance is read from token.balanceOf(address(this)).
The token instance created from rootToken is used for the external mint call.
rootToken controls the external contract invoked by safeTransfer on the exit path.
withdrawer address is decoded from topic1 of the supplied RLP log.
amount is decoded from the RLP log data field.
tokenBalance is the subtrahend of the amount - tokenBalance shortfall computation feeding mint.
amount is the minuend of the amount - tokenBalance shortfall computation.
Decoded amount is passed to safeTransfer for the withdrawer.
withdrawer is the recipient of the safeTransfer call.
exitTokens branches on tokenBalance < amount and performs the subtraction amount - tokenBalance.
exitTokens conditionally invokes the external mint call before transferring tokens.
exitTokens performs an external token transfer to a log-derived withdrawer without a reentrancy guard.
